slot: Your question, plus the daily report
summary: The S&P 500 fell to 7,619.98 today, down 0.48%, as chip stocks were hit hard after several top AI company CEOs publicly called for slowing the pace of AI development. The Nasdaq 100, which is heavy in tech names, dropped 0.80%. The 10 year Treasury yield, which is the interest rate the US government pays to borrow money for a decade, touched 5% before pulling back to 4.96%, a level that makes borrowing more expensive for companies and competes with stocks for investor money. Bitcoin rose 2.44% to 78,715.64, a rare bright spot. Wednesday brings a Federal Reserve interest rate decision that traders currently price at over 92% odds of a hike.
